title: FSS atomic site capture plan v1
description: Atomic direct RTSP/NVR AVC/HEVC/JPEG and protected UniFi AVC/HEVC planning. The complete site digest binds canonical manifest and probe receipts plus exact native approvals; UniFi additionally binds the actual protected-export fingerprint, camera and exact selected view/route through the existing native wrapper. No site executor, rights-lease verification or current-liveness claim. JPEG sources use the existing bounded datagram-capture planner and require at most 256 pictures; native JPEG plans contain no independent AVC/HEVC pin journal or cadence option. UniFi JPEG capture is not admitted.

reserved_pins_root.description: Independent journal parent reserved by the site request, displayed and approval-bound whenever the site contains JPEG. Native JPEG capture does not create or use an AVC/HEVC pin journal.

argv.description: Exact native arguments, with an initial jpeg subcommand for direct JPEG or from-unifi for protected UniFi, and option/value pairs after it. No --approve option is emitted. Treat plans as private operator material: file references and direct-source route queries can remain. UniFi route capabilities stay in the protected export and never enter argv.

native_unifi_plan.description: The exact existing from-unifi v1 single-capture wrapper. The camera ID and private-file identity are represented only by digests. Native authority remains explicit while presentation and control capabilities are redacted.
